name: Cutthroat
concept_ja: 水没した書庫の格子を忍び抜ける若い密航者。刃を振るう瞬間ではなく、結び目を静かに切る手元と横目で警戒する顔で機敏さを描く。
subject_en: A lean young adult man with short dark curls and a small ivory ear cuff, shown waist-up in a forward crouch. He wears a tar-black sleeveless salt-stained vest and an oxidized-crimson triangular neck scarf. At chest height his right hand uses a short crescent boarding knife to cut a coarse rope knot; his watchful face and knife remain close together in the central seventy percent. Romantic illustrated fantasy, fine expressive ink contours, restrained painterly shadows.
silhouette_ja: 片肩を下げた細い三角形。短い三日月刃と片側へ流れる赤いスカーフで遠目にも判別。
motif_ja: 三日月形の仕事刃、象牙色の耳飾り、粗い一重結び。
background_en: A dim tide gate beneath the Drowned Archive, green-black stone bars, a narrow ivory reflection from water and a single aged-brass hinge. Background detail remains subordinate to the face and hands.
continuity_ja: Pirate の赤錆色・タール布・縄を基礎形として提示。28 の腰道具に同じ三日月刃と赤布が継承される。固定アクションを示す発光や紋章は描かない。

name: Raider
concept_ja: 潮位が上がる前に書物箱を引き揚げる、がっしりした中年の女性船員。引き寄せた鉤と肩に巻いた縄で強引な突破力を表す。
subject_en: A broad-shouldered middle-aged woman with closely cropped iron-gray hair and warm brown skin, waist-up and turning against a heavy rope. She has a patched crimson storm cape over a tarred work apron. An aged-brass three-pronged grappling hook and a tight coil of pale rope rest across her chest as she hauls a sealed salvage crate from below the crop. Her face, hook and rope form one compact central group. Illustrated romantic fantasy with precise ink contours and weathered painted materials.
silhouette_ja: 広い肩の逆三角形に、片側の大きな縄の輪。細身の21とは重心と体積を反転。
motif_ja: 三本爪の鉤、太い縄輪、補修跡の多い雨具。
background_en: The archive's flooded cargo steps in a night squall; broken green-black masonry, a dim coral-encrusted bollard and receding ivory wave edges. No ship battle or secondary crowd.
continuity_ja: 21 と同じ海の仕事道具を重装備化。28 は三本爪と縄輪を引き継ぐため、鉤の形を明瞭にする。

name: Corsair
concept_ja: 崩れた回廊の上を渡る若い女性の索具係。片手で高い縄をつかみ、もう片手の短い観測鏡で次の足場を確かめる。
subject_en: A wiry young adult woman with dark skin and a short braided ponytail, framed from the waist up as she grips a rigging line beside her head. She wears a fitted tar-black sailor jacket, a single crimson shoulder pennant and small bone toggles, without a grand captain's hat. Her free hand holds a short brass spyglass near the sternum, angled toward a gap in the archive wall. The lifted elbow makes a taut triangular silhouette while face and spyglass stay centrally readable. Expressive inked fantasy portrait with restrained painted shading.
silhouette_ja: 上げた肘と索具が作る細長い三角。短い編み髪と片肩の旗布が風の方向を示す。
motif_ja: 短い観測鏡、骨の留め具、張った一本の縄。
background_en: A high broken gallery of the coastal archive, one sliver of storm-dark sea between green-black pillars, a distant sail reduced to a faint shape. Cool ivory rim light, no large magical glow.
continuity_ja: 海賊を全員剣士にせず、航行技能で分ける。現場用の短い鏡と軽装を使い、26 の指揮官用航海器具とは格を分ける。

name: Buccaneer
concept_ja: 海底回廊に詳しい壮年の潜水回収者。肩に担いだ短い銛と、胸で抱える珊瑚付きの回収壺で海との近さを描く。
subject_en: A sturdy older man with a salt-and-pepper beard and a low tied crimson headcloth, shown waist-up after a salvage dive. Wet tarred leather panels cover his shoulders; one bare forearm cradles a small coral-crusted archive urn at chest level. A compact barbed salvage harpoon rests diagonally behind his shoulder, its tip safely inside the crop. His relaxed, weather-beaten expression contrasts with the tense younger pirates. Detailed romantic fantasy linework, muted oxidized reds and subtle ivory highlights on wet materials.
silhouette_ja: 丸い壺を抱く低い重心と、肩から斜めに出る短い銛。帽子や長髪を使わず差別化。
motif_ja: 枝珊瑚、濡れた革、欠けた回収壺。
background_en: A narrow flooded cloister just inside the Drowned Archive; tide lines on green-black stone and a faint brass mooring ring. Water is a subdued strip behind the shoulders, not a blue tropical ocean.
continuity_ja: 珊瑚と回収物で陣営の環境適応を示す。壺に読める文字や未知の能力を意味するルーンは付けない。

name: Powder Charge
concept_ja: 海水を防ぐ黒い封蝋と赤布で包まれた、使い切りの小さな火薬容器。派手な爆発ではなく短い導火線の一点の火と割れ始めた封蝋に不可逆な選択を感じさせる。
subject_en: An object portrait of one squat sealed ceramic powder charge on a damp stone ledge, wrapped in tar-black cloth and a worn oxidized-crimson binding. A narrow aged-brass carrying handle, chipped ivory ceramic edge and one short braided fuse with a tiny ember identify its function. No person, no gun, no explosion, no shrapnel and no construction diagram. The entire vessel and fuse sit in the central seventy percent, lit like a precious but expendable archive artifact. Fine inked contours and restrained painterly material shading.
silhouette_ja: 低い樽形の塊に短い取手と一本の導火線。人物カードの肩・顔の反復を切る明確な物体シルエット。
motif_ja: 黒い封蝋、赤い巻布、消えそうな火点。
background_en: An out-of-focus green-black seawall recess in the archive's lower dock, a little salt crust and a dark water reflection. Keep the tiny ember the only warm light source.
continuity_ja: 実名と Burn 能力に合わせた消耗物。全体攻撃の表現を爆発被害や流血にせず、消費前の緊張にとどめる。FLAME などの固定アクション印は描かない。

name: Privateer
concept_ja: 古い通行権を盾に封鎖を抜ける、痩身の中年男性の船長。傷んだ正装と胸元の航海器具で、船員より上の専門性を出す。
subject_en: A composed middle-aged man with a close black beard streaked once with gray, shown waist-up in three-quarter profile. He wears a narrow weathered tricorn and a fitted tar-black naval coat with asymmetrical crimson lining and sparse aged-brass braid. One gloved hand holds a closed brass divider and a rolled unlettered vellum permit with a dark wax seal close to his chest. The sharp hat corner, high collar and compact instruments form a deliberate triangular composition. Romantic illustrated fantasy, careful ink contours, subdued sea-worn textures.
silhouette_ja: 細い三角帽と高い襟の縦長像。華美な肩鎧ではなく細身の正装で役職を示す。
motif_ja: 閉じた航海用コンパス、封蝋付きの許可巻紙、擦れた真鍮飾緒。
background_en: The archive's chained harbor entrance in shallow focus, a brass-bound green-black door and the suggestion of a storm beyond. Do not include readable permits, flags with symbols or a second focal character.
continuity_ja: 航海器具は Pirate の実用品として直線的にまとめ、Scholar の同心円儀器とは造形を分ける。Common より整った装備だが Legendary の大きな装飾鎧は使わない。

name: Freebooter
concept_ja: 冠水した武器庫を独力で渡る褐色肌の壮年女性。片肩の珊瑚状の回収鎧と胸を横切る短い両端鉤で、自作装備の荒々しさを出す。
subject_en: A tall middle-aged woman with deep brown skin, shaved temples and one thick braid swept forward, portrayed waist-up. She wears a crimson sash across tarred black layered work leathers and a single salvaged shoulder plate encrusted with small dull coral branches. She braces a short double-ended boarding hook horizontally across her upper torso, both ends comfortably inside the crop. Her lifted chin and square calm gaze convey independence. Romantic fantasy illustration with strong ink silhouettes and restrained brass, crimson and ivory accents.
silhouette_ja: 左右差の大きい肩装備に、胸の横棒。縦長の26、斜線の24と構図を変える。
motif_ja: 珊瑚の肩当て、短い両端鉤、太い一本編み。
background_en: A half-submerged arsenal doorway within the archive, overlapping dark green stone slabs and a faint band of night sea. One weathered rope hangs out of focus behind the bare shoulder.
continuity_ja: 24 の海底回収文化を自作装備へ発展させる。Rare の巨大さや殺傷結果を使わず、専門道具と自立した姿勢で Uncommon を区別する。

name: Pirate Quartermaster
concept_ja: Cutthroat の身軽な仕事道具と Raider の引き揚げ装備を束ねる補給責任者。人間同士の融合姿ではなく、二つの技能を引き継いだ完成形として描く。
subject_en: A capable adult woman in her thirties with auburn hair in a compact braided bun, shown waist-up at an archive loading table. Her tar-black reinforced vest has the same oxidized-crimson triangular scarf as the Cutthroat. She checks a small unlabeled wooden supply tally in one hand while the other holds the Raider's distinctive three-pronged brass grappling hook. A short crescent knife and tight pale rope coil are secured visibly across her chest harness, not dangling beyond the crop. Her broad asymmetrical triangular silhouette reads as organized competence. Fine inked romantic fantasy with understated painted weathering.
silhouette_ja: 太いハーネスと片肩の縄輪で安定した三角。胸前の鉤・刃・札を一塊にまとめ、道具の散乱を防ぐ。
motif_ja: 21 の三日月刃と赤スカーフ、22 の三本爪と縄輪、無文字の補給札。
background_en: A sheltered logistics alcove above the Drowned Archive's flooded dock, two blurred sealed crates and green-black masonry with worn brass corner guards. No readable inventory or signs.
continuity_ja: 実レシピ 21 + 22 → 28 の視覚的継承。装備の形を素材カードと一致させる。進化を別の超能力や肉体融合として表現しない。

name: Dreadnaught
concept_ja: 船首のような重い肩装備で通路を塞ぐ、白髪の老将。勝利の後まで残る威圧感を、裂けた赤い旗布と背後の無人の回廊で示す。
subject_en: An imposing elderly man with long swept-back white hair and a short squared beard, chest-up from a restrained low angle. His dark salvaged breastplate and broad asymmetrical shoulder armor resemble the angular prow of an old ship, edged in tarnished brass and small dead coral. A torn oxidized-crimson pennant folds over one shoulder. He holds a broad cutlass upright close to his face, blade and face sharing the central composition, with no strike or injured opponent. His silhouette is massive and still, rendered in romantic fantasy inkwork and controlled painterly shadows.
silhouette_ja: 低い視点から見る船首型の巨大な逆三角。白髪の小さい明部と太い縦の剣で読み取れる。
motif_ja: 船首形の鎧、裂けた旗布、白髪、くすんだ珊瑚。
background_en: A tall, empty archive causeway disappearing into sea mist behind him, green-black buttresses and tiny fading ember flecks low in the background. No corpses, gore, explosion or burning victims.
continuity_ja: Rare の圧力を人物の大きさと静止で表現。撃破に連動する実パッシブは残火程度に示唆し、29 自体を船や新しい機械兵器へ置き換えない。

name: Marauder
concept_ja: 既存の赤毛の剣士を陣営の象徴として再描画する。大きく流れる髪、装飾肩鎧、挑むような目線を残し、海風と潮を受けた書庫の征服者へつなぐ。
subject_en: Preserve the existing Marauder portrait identity: a youthful adult woman with voluminous long auburn-red hair swept dramatically sideways, sharp confident eyes, ornate flared brass shoulder armor over a near-black fitted coat and a sweeping deep crimson-purple cape. Recompose her waist-up in a commanding three-quarter turn, with the elegant cutlass crossing the lower chest inside the central seventy percent. Keep her face and rich flowing hair the primary focal point, not a pirate hat, eyepatch or new mask. Refined romantic anime-fantasy linework with elegant expressive eyes, detailed ink contours and restrained painterly shading. Tarnish and salt-worn edges update the materials without erasing her recognizable regalia.
silhouette_ja: 片側へ大きく流れる赤い長髪、翼状の肩鎧、胸の斜めの剣。既存画像の特徴を保った唯一の華やかな大三角。
motif_ja: 赤い長髪、湾曲した真鍮の肩装飾、深紅紫のマント、優雅な剣。
background_en: The upper seaward terrace of the Drowned Archive under a night squall, aged-brass balustrade and green-black towers fading into mist. A restrained ivory rim light picks out hair and sword; no gold coin shower, giant aura or decorative card border.
continuity_ja: solana/client/public/img/cards/legendary/pirate.jpg を人物参照の正とする。顔立ち・髪色・剣士の姿を維持し、背景と素材を現行世界へ統一する。

name: Apprentice
concept_ja: 濡れた頁を一枚ずつ救う若い書庫見習い。大きめの作業衣と手持ちの丸い拡大鏡に、まだ身についていない仕事への集中を表す。
subject_en: A young adult woman with a short dark bob and a loose strand tucked behind one ear, shown waist-up, studying a single unlettered vellum sheet held at chest height. She wears an oversized desaturated-violet apprentice smock over an ivory linen collar. A plain circular aged-brass hand lens enlarges one small area of the sheet; face, lens and hands form a compact centered oval. Her expression is attentive rather than awestruck. Romantic illustrated fantasy with delicate ink contours and restrained painted shadows, no school insignia or floating spell symbols.
silhouette_ja: 大きめの丸い袖、短いボブ、片手の小さな円。細身でも肩を水平にして Pirate の三角と分ける。
motif_ja: 飾りのない丸い手持ちレンズ、薄い象牙色の一枚紙、紫の作業袖。
background_en: A modest conservation desk within the Drowned Archive, green-black stone niches and one shaded brass reading lamp, with a faint damp tide line far behind. All shelf detail remains soft.
continuity_ja: Scholar の円形道具を最も簡素な形で導入。38 へ手持ちレンズの真鍮輪と紫の袖を引き継ぐ。頁は読める本文を持たない。

name: Archivist
concept_ja: 潮に濡れた記録を巻き直す、中年の書庫管理者。円筒の収納容器と二本の平たい索引ひもで整理の仕事を表す。
subject_en: A middle-aged man with warm brown skin, close-cropped curls and a neat short beard, shown waist-up. He wears a practical indigo sleeveless tabard over ivory rolled sleeves, with a narrow violet cloth band at the collar. He holds a weathered cylindrical brass scroll case against his chest while securing two flat ivory index ribbons around a vellum roll. Rounded shoulders and the scroll case create a calm compact silhouette. Fine expressive ink contours and muted painterly fantasy shading; no armor or grand magical staff.
silhouette_ja: 丸めた肩と胸の太い円筒。袖をまくった両腕が楕円をつくり、31 の小さなレンズと差を出す。
motif_ja: 太い真鍮の巻物筒、二本の平たい索引ひも、巻き直した羊皮紙。
background_en: A low archive shelving alcove of green-black stone, sealed vellum cylinders receding into shadow, a thin ivory reflection from distant water. No legible labels or numerical filing codes.
continuity_ja: 記録を扱う実務者として描く。38 は同型の円筒と二本の索引ひもを継承し、素材が見て取れるようにする。

name: Mage
concept_ja: 海霧に残る記録の痕跡を、小さな円環の間で調べる成人の研究者。魔法の大演出ではなく実験中の集中を中心にする。
subject_en: An androgynous adult scholar with a shoulder-length silver-blond undercut, shown chest-up in a close three-quarter portrait. They wear a simple desaturated-indigo high-collar wrap and a narrow vellum-colored shoulder stole. Both hands hold two small nested brass rings at the sternum, where a faint thread of pale sea mist curls through the empty center. The small phenomenon has no recognizable elemental icon or glyph. Their focused profile, clean hair shape and rings remain within the central seventy percent. Romantic fantasy illustration with crisp ink contours and minimal controlled glow.
silhouette_ja: 首元の細い縦線と顎の横顔、胸の二重円。長い杖や尖り帽子を避ける。
motif_ja: 入れ子の小円環、紙色の細い肩布、ごく薄い霧の糸。
background_en: A damp experimental niche in the archive, green-black stone under subdued violet reflected light and a blurred closed specimen shelf. No bright laboratory machinery or broad glowing spell circle.
continuity_ja: 31・32 と同じ地に足のついた Common。魔法は世界の記録を観察する小現象に限定し、実装されていない能力や固定 VOID 印を示さない。

name: Sage
concept_ja: 潮の音と古い記録を照合する高齢女性。低くまとめた白髪、半月眼鏡、膝から持ち上げた折り畳み図で、静かな経験の厚みを描く。
subject_en: An elderly woman with lined features and white hair in a low rounded bun, portrayed waist-up seated at a stone reading desk. She wears a faded violet shawl over an indigo plain gown and small half-moon brass spectacles. Her hands support a folded ivory vellum folio opened just below her chin; its page shows only sparse nonverbal tide arcs and dots, not writing or a game diagram. Her gentle direct gaze is the main focal point. Elegant romantic fantasy ink drawing with soft, restrained painted shadows and visible fabric wear.
silhouette_ja: 低い丸髷、丸い肩掛け、下辺を広げる折り畳み図。硬い装備や背の高い頭飾りは使わない。
motif_ja: 半月眼鏡、折り目のある図紙、擦り切れた紫の肩掛け。
background_en: A quiet arched reading bay overlooking dark rain, green-black window tracery and a small aged-brass lamp reflected in wet stone. Keep the scene intimate and grounded.
continuity_ja: 年齢や知恵をレアリティと同一視せず、Common の熟練生活者として描く。39 の超常的な洞察とは光量と道具の規模を分ける。

name: Burning Tome
concept_ja: 閉じた記録を一度だけ明らかにする代わりに、自らを失う古書。焦げた頁の隙間に、星のような紙粉と薄い光が現れる瞬間を描く。
subject_en: An object portrait of one open, heavily worn indigo-violet leather tome on a low green-black stone reading rest. Its aged-brass clasps hang loose and its ivory vellum pages curl at singed outer edges. A few tiny orange embers and pale paper flecks rise from one margin; between the pages a restrained ivory light reveals faint overlapping circular impressions without readable writing, runes, an eye icon or a literal opponent hand. Keep the book compact and centered, with the entire open-page silhouette safely inside the central seventy percent. Refined inked fantasy illustration with delicate painterly material shading, no person and no conflagration.
silhouette_ja: 開いた本の低い翼形。中央の背と丸まった二枚の頁を明瞭にし、火柱で輪郭を隠さない。
motif_ja: 焦げた象牙色の頁、外れた真鍮の留め具、少数の火粉と円形の記録痕。
background_en: A dark conservation alcove in the Drowned Archive with soft green-black shelving and a faint damp stone reflection. The small revealed light inside the book is the sole bright focal accent.
continuity_ja: 実名 Burning Tome と手札公開の Burn 能力を、代償を伴う知の開示として表現。固定アクションや目の UI アイコンを絵に焼き込まない。25 とは容器の形と火の扱いを変える。

name: Diviner
concept_ja: 潮だまりの反射を読み取る中年女性の観測者。顔の近くまで持ち上げた浅い水盤と、波紋に重ねる細い輪で専門性を表す。
subject_en: A middle-aged woman with deep brown skin and long dark hair wrapped in a compact indigo headscarf, framed waist-up in profile. She wears a desaturated-violet layered mantle with an ivory crescent-shaped collar. Both hands lift a shallow aged-brass water bowl to upper chest height; a fine suspended ring casts a simple round reflection on the dark water. Her concentrated face and bowl occupy the same tight central area, the water catching a small ivory highlight rather than projecting a vision. Detailed ink contours and restrained painted fantasy shading.
silhouette_ja: 頭布の滑らかな輪郭、横顔、胸の浅い半円の水盤。下が広がるローブを主役にしない。
motif_ja: 浅い真鍮の水盤、吊られた細い円環、波紋の反射。
background_en: A circular drainage chamber inside the archive, green-black stone, a blurred narrow sluice and desaturated indigo shadows. No giant clairvoyant face or literal future scene in the water.
continuity_ja: Scholar の円を液体と観測へ展開。水は現行世界の潮と結びつけ、STORM の固定属性表現にはしない。

name: Arcanist
concept_ja: 水没した装置の構造を解読する、短い銀髪の壮年男性。細い肩の上に小型の分解円盤を置き、精密な指先で調整する。
subject_en: A lean mature man with short silver hair, a clean-shaven angular face and one dark glove, shown waist-up. He wears a fitted ink-indigo coat with a violet standing collar and a narrow ivory sleeve lining. One hand supports a small disassembled brass memory dial at chest height while the other aligns a circular lens in front of it; three nested physical rings remain close together rather than floating around the body. A focused downward gaze links the face to the instrument. Romantic illustrated fantasy, exact expressive ink edges and controlled painterly brass reflections.
silhouette_ja: 細身の直立像に、左右の指先が作る横長の楕円。短髪と詰めた襟で36・38と分ける。
motif_ja: 分解した三重円盤、片手だけの暗い手袋、調整用の薄いレンズ。
background_en: A sealed instrument recess in the archive's inner library, green-black stone ribs and softly blurred vellum diagrams with no legible symbols. No steam engine, exposed industrial gears or modern screen.
continuity_ja: Engineer の製作・動力装置ではなく、記録を読む光学道具として描く。専門性は機構の精度で表現し、大きなオーラや身体変容を足さない。

name: Scholar Lorekeeper
concept_ja: 見習いの観察眼と管理者の保存技術を一つにした記録継承者。胸元のレンズと巻物筒を重ね、読み解くことと守ることを同じ姿にする。
subject_en: An adult scholar with warm olive skin, long dark hair gathered in a neat low knot and a calm resolute gaze, portrayed waist-up. They wear a desaturated-violet smock refined into an indigo layered mantle with ivory cuffs. The Apprentice's plain circular brass hand lens is now clipped to a short articulated reading arm above the Archivist's distinctive cylindrical brass scroll case. Two flat ivory index ribbons visibly bind the open vellum roll held across the chest. Face, lens, cylinder and both hands form a single orderly central oval. Romantic fantasy inkwork with restrained painted weathering, no floating books or extra arms.
silhouette_ja: 端正な低い結び髪と、胸で重なるレンズの円・巻物筒の円柱。二本の白いひもが縦の識別線になる。
motif_ja: 31 の素朴な真鍮レンズ、32 の巻物筒と二本の索引ひも、継ぎ直した紫の袖。
background_en: A protected reading vault deeper inside the Drowned Archive, green-black circular shelving recesses and one distant ivory lamp reflection. Background books are indistinct and carry no readable text.
continuity_ja: 実レシピ 31 + 32 → 38 に対応。二つの道具と素材を継承し、人物の肉体融合にはしない。Legendary の Oracle と区別するため単眼鏡・装飾肩鎧・豪華な本は使わない。

name: Seer
concept_ja: 幾重もの記録の痕跡を重ねて読む、白い三つ編みの高齢女性。三層の薄い円形記録板が一つの像へ重なる瞬間を、静かな権威として描く。
subject_en: An elderly woman with long white hair braided over one shoulder, deep-set dark eyes and a dignified still expression, shown chest-up. Her broad rounded indigo mantle has an aged-brass circular clasp and a restrained violet lining. At sternum height she holds three thin translucent vellum discs slightly offset, their worn circular impressions aligning into a single brighter ivory contour. One large incomplete brass observation ring sits softly behind her shoulders as architectural equipment, not a halo or UI symbol. Preserve face and discs as the main centered focal group. Elegant romantic fantasy ink contours with carefully limited painterly luminosity.
silhouette_ja: 幅のある丸い外套と一本の白い三つ編み。背後の欠けた大円、胸の小さな三層円で格を出す。
motif_ja: 三枚の薄い記録円板、重なって強まる輪郭、白い編み髪。
background_en: A high observation gallery above the Drowned Archive's inner court, green-black stone arches lost in mist and a low-saturation star chart reduced to arcs and dots. No cosmic sky portal or literal numerical stat display.
continuity_ja: 実パッシブの自分の stat imprint 最大3件による強化を、三層の記録が重なる意匠として示唆。カード数値や未実装の予知結果を描かない。

name: Oracle
concept_ja: 既存の若い黒髪の読書家を、沈んだ書庫の中枢にいる象徴的人物として継承する。単眼鏡越しの視線と装飾本を中心に、知識を扱う静かな強さを描く。
subject_en: Preserve the existing Oracle identity: a youthful adult man with thick softly tousled black hair carrying muted violet highlights, a delicate confident face, a small round brass monocle on a fine chain, ornate dark shoulder armor edged in aged brass and a deep indigo-violet draped coat. Recompose him waist-up in a calm seated three-quarter pose, holding the familiar ornate leather-bound open book at chest height so his monocle, face, gloved hand and book form the compact central focal group. Retain the book's elegant brass geometric cover ornament as physical decoration without readable writing or a fixed action icon. Refined romantic anime-fantasy features, detailed expressive ink contours and restrained painterly shading; not an elderly wizard or photorealistic mage.
silhouette_ja: ふくらみのある黒髪、丸い単眼鏡、装飾肩鎧、胸に斜めに抱えた本。既存の顔・道具の関係を保つ。
motif_ja: 鎖付きの単眼鏡、装飾本、真鍮縁の肩鎧、深い藍紫の布。
background_en: The sealed central reading chamber of the Drowned Archive, an immense green-black circular catalog niche and a distant aged-brass astrolabe dissolved into shadow. A small ivory reflection from the open pages lights his hand and lower face; no overwhelming spell vortex or decorative card border.
continuity_ja: solana/client/public/img/cards/legendary/scholar.jpg を人物参照の正とする。若さ・黒髪・単眼鏡・装飾本を守り、既存の美麗な線画から連続した表現にする。
